text:
Kai: PSA: if you bring a yoga mat to the office please write your name on it. Someone stole mine for nap rotation and now it's leading a different life. :sleeping:
Maya: is nap rotation an official program? asking for a friend. :nerd_face:
Ravi: unofficial but widely endorsed. we have rules: 1) don't hog conference rooms 2) the plant is not a pillow 3) return borrowed mats within 24h.
ops-bot: Facilities reminder: Shared items should be labeled with initials. Unclaimed items after 14 days will be donated.
June: Also, someone left three mismatched chopsticks in the kitchen drawer. if you lost one, they're now a tiny family. :chopsticks:
Kai: update: found my mat. turns out it was behind the standing desk pedal, living its best life under the cables. 1 less mystery. :relieved:
Maya: celebration: unofficial nap rotation continues. :party_popper:
Ravi: I demand ceremonial snacks to honor the mat's return.
June: I'll bring doughnuts if Ravi sings a lullaby.
Maya: record it for the onboarding playlist. :musical_note:
